Name: Aarav Kumar Singh

Work Experience:
- 2023--2023: Mathematics Research Intern, Indian Statistical Institute, Kolkata. Conducted exploratory research on combinatorial optimization problems under the supervision of senior faculty. Collaborated with a team of researchers to analyze mathematical models related to network flows. Prepared detailed reports documenting experimental results and statistical findings. Presented outcomes in weekly seminars and received constructive feedback for further improvement.
- 2022--2022: Applied Mathematics Intern, Tata Institute of Fundamental Research, Mumbai. Assisted in the development of simulation models for stochastic processes used in financial mathematics. Implemented numerical techniques for solving differential equations using Python
